name: BASS
hw: Microgravity Science Glovebox, fan-driven flow duct built for SPICE
obj: Flammability limits of solid materials such as fabrics and plastics.
fuel: PMMA (78 of 121 samples), SIBAL fabric, Nomex blends, Ultem and paraffin and Japan wax candles
cond: 121 samples tested from 2012-03-30 to 2013-06-01 as spheres, candles, slabs and sheets of 1–2 cm; O₂ is not recorded in the cleaned table (air assumed)
meas: Sample material, form, size and burn configuration (wake, opposed flow or unspecified) for each run

name: BASS-II
full: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
hw: Microgravity Science Glovebox, fan-driven flow duct built for SPICE
obj: Follow-on study of solid material flammability in microgravity.
fuel: PMMA (96 of 129 tests), SIBAL fabric, Nomex and wax, as rods, films, slabs and fabrics
cond: 129 tests from 2014-02-14 to 2016-02-26, airflow 0–38.5 cm/s, sample thickness 0.1–5 mm; O₂ is the measured chamber level before each test
meas: Initial and final O₂, CO₂ and CO in the chamber, airflow settings, radiometer gain, number of video frames

name: Saffire
full: Spacecraft Fire Safety Demonstration (I, II, III)
hw: Cygnus cargo vehicle, uncrewed, after leaving the ISS
obj: Flammability of solid materials, demonstrated at spacecraft scale.
fuel: SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric (I and III); silicone, PMMA, SIBAL and Nomex samples (II)
cond: Saffire-I: 2 burns of a 94 × 40.6 cm sheet at 20 cm/s; Saffire-II: 10 samples at 20 cm/s; Saffire-III: 2 burns at 30 cm/s, concurrent and opposed flow; O₂ is not recorded for Saffire-III
meas: O₂ at start and end, airflow direction, ignition power and time, burn time, burn length and flame spread rate (microgravity and 1 g for Saffire-II)

name: CFI-G
hw: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Flames at the highest oxygen concentrations tested in microgravity.
fuel: Ethane, propane and butane (333 tests: 179 normal, 154 inverse)
cond: Normal flames at 18–40% O₂ and 0.51–3.04 bar; inverse flames fed 12–85% O₂ from a spherical burner at 0.50–3.31 bar
meas: Outcome (self-extinguished, flow-terminated or no sustained flame), burn time, peak burner temperature, adiabatic flame temperature, stoichiometric mixture fraction; 7 tests flagged as cool flames

name: BRE
hw: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Materials flammability in still atmospheres as a function of material properties.
fuel: Ethylene (16 test days) and methane (2), at 50–100% fuel concentration
cond: 18 test days from 2019-02-08 to 2021-01-28 on 25 mm and 50 mm burners at O₂ levels of 21, 25, 26.5, 34 and 40%
meas: Burner size, fuel concentration, O₂ levels tested per day and number of flames ignited (194 in total)

name: SAME
fuel: Teflon, Kapton, silicone rubber, lampwick and dibutyl phthalate, 4 tests each
cond: 20 tests: a baseline plus one factor varied at a time (weight loss rate 1–2 mg/min, aging 1–20 min, air flow 5–10 cm/s); O₂ is not recorded in the cleaned table (air assumed)

name: SAME-R
full: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment, Reflight
obj: Second round of fire detection tests in microgravity.
fuel: Kapton, silicone, lampwick, Pyrell and Teflon (109 test records)
cond: Test numbers 48–114 over 56 campaign days from July to September; inlet velocity 0–8.1 cm/s, fresh and aged smoke (aging 0.35–32 min), 46 aging runs; O₂ is not recorded in the cleaned table (air assumed)
meas: Smoke and aerosol particle measurements, temperature class, inlet velocity, aging time, RT/R0 ratio (1.22–1.48) and test duration (60–120 s)

name: FLEX
hw: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Suppression of fire by diluting the chamber atmosphere with carbon dioxide or helium.
fuel: Methanol (157 tests) and heptane (117) droplets, 1.1–4.7 mm initial diameter
cond: 274 tests from 2009-03-05 to 2011-12-08 at 12–34% O₂ and 70–309 kPa, with CO₂ (123 tests), helium (50) or no diluent (101)
meas: Droplet diameter at ignition and at extinction, burn rate, burn time and whether the flame went out (186 of 274 extinguished)

name: FLEX-2
hw: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Follow-on study of flame extinguishment with burning droplets.
fuel: Iso-octane, n-octane, heptane, decane, ethanol and three mixtures (heptane/iso-octane, propanol/glycerol)
cond: Planned test matrix of 8 fuels at 17–30% O₂ and 0.5–3 atm, nitrogen or helium diluent, flow 0.1–5 cm/s, droplets 1.5–5 mm
meas: Planned matrix only, no measured results in the cleaned table

name: CFI
hw: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Cool flames on burning liquid droplets.
fuel: Dodecane and dodecane/iso-dodecane blends (60/40 and 75/25), 79 runs
cond: Runs from 2017-03-09 to 2017-08-21 at 17–21% O₂ and 0.5–5 atm, with up to 59% helium in the diluent
meas: Run time, pressure, gas composition, fiber-supported droplet or free droplet, repeat-condition count

name: E-FIELD
full: Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames (ACME)
hw: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Mimics partial gravity by acting with an electric field on the ions that occur naturally in flames.
fuel: Methane and ethylene, pure or diluted (25–100% fuel), on coflow and gas-jet burners
cond: 20 test days from 2018-03-14 to 2018-11-15, positive and negative mesh polarity; O₂ is not recorded in the cleaned table (air assumed)
meas: Test day, burner type, mesh polarity, fuel concentration levels and number of flames ignited (219 in total)

name: s-Flame
hw: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: One of the six ACME gaseous flame experiments.
fuel: Hydrogen, methane and ethylene, pure or mixed, diluted with nitrogen or helium
cond: 18 test days from 2019-09-11 to 2020-07-08 at about 21% and 30% O₂, in nitrogen or helium diluent
meas: Test day, O₂ levels, fuel mixture, inert gas fraction and number of flames ignited (276 in total)

name: CLD Flame
hw: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Laminar coflow diffusion flames at varied fuel concentration in microgravity.
fuel: Methane and ethylene, pure or diluted with nitrogen (0–100% fuel)
cond: 32 test days from 2017-11-15 to 2021-03-03 in methane-based, ethylene-based and improved-coflow series; O₂ is not recorded in the cleaned table (air assumed)
meas: Fuel concentration range swept per test day, mass-flow-controller limits and number of flames ignited (344 in total)

name: Flame Design
hw: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack
obj: Normal and inverse gaseous flames designed over a wide range of oxygen level and pressure.
fuel: Ethylene (normal and inverse) and propane (normal), 327 tests: 207 normal, 120 inverse
cond: Normal flames at 19.8–40% O₂ and 0.93–1.32 atm; inverse flames with 21–85% O₂ at the burner and 0.42–3.03 atm; tests from 2019-04-25 to 2022-02-04
meas: Fuel, O₂ and N₂ mass flows, O₂ and fuel mole fractions before and after each test, pressure rise, stoichiometric mixture fraction and adiabatic flame temperature

name: SPICE
hw: Microgravity Science Glovebox, fan-driven flow duct
obj: Smoke point of gaseous flames in a co-flowing stream.
fuel: Propylene (pure or 50–75% in nitrogen), propane, ethylene and methane
cond: 368 analysed flames in 125 events on 11 test days from 2009-02-14 to 2009-06-23; co-flow air 0–67 cm/s, nozzles 0.41–1.60 mm; O₂ is not recorded in the cleaned table (air assumed)
meas: Fuel flow, air co-flow rate, ignition and flame-off times and burn duration (17–655 s)
